text:
Wales: Craig Bellamy announces 26-man squad for UEFA Nations League matches against Norway and Portugal
Harry Wilson and Joe Rodon among those recalled to Wales squad by Craig Bellamy; the Dragons face two crucial UEFA Nations League matches - Norway in Oslo on November 14 and Portugal in Cardiff on November 17
Wednesday 4 November 2026 10:33, UK
Wales boss Craig Bellamy has recalled several players, including Harry Wilson and Joe Rodon, for November's Nations League fixtures.
The Dragons sit third in Group A4 after beating Norway during the previous international break, but also suffering two defeats to Denmark and one against Portugal.
On Saturday November 14, they face Norway in Oslo, before a sold-out clash with Portugal at the Cardiff City Stadium on Tuesday November 17.
Leeds winger Wilson withdrew from the squad for the previous camp in September with a quadricep injury, while club team-mate Rodon has seemingly recovered from a hamstring injury suffered during the 1-1 draw with Brentford on August 30.
Elsewhere, Man Utd goalkeeper Karl Darlow also returns to the squad, while U21 stopper Joe Duncan earns his first senior call-up.
Cardiff's Rubin Colwill earns his first call-up since last November, while Kai Andrews - on loan at Oxford from Coventry - returns for the first time since June.
If Wales finish in the top two, they will progress to the quarter-finals, but if they finish third, they would face a relegation play-off against a team from League B. Both matches will take place in March.
Should they finish bottom of their group, they will either face a relegation play-off or direct relegation.
Wales squad in full
Goalkeepers: Karl Darlow (Manchester United), Danny Ward (Wrexham), Joe Duncan (Southend United, on loan from Bristol City)
Defenders: Jay Dasilva (Coventry City), Jayden Lienou (Leeds United), Ben Davies (Tottenham Hotspur), Chris Mepham (West Bromwich Albion), Joe Rodon (Leeds United), Ben Cabango (Swansea City), Neco Williams (Nottingham Forest), Connor Roberts (Burnley)
Midfielders: Ethan Ampadu (Leeds United), Josh Sheehan (Bolton Wanderers), Kai Andrews (Oxford United, on loan from Coventry City), Rubin Colwill (Cardiff City), Joel Colwill (Cardiff City), Harry Wilson (Leeds United), Liam Cullen (Leicester City)
Forwards: Cian Ashford (Cardiff City), Brennan Johnson (Everton), Sorba Thomas (Hull City), Lewis Koumas (Liverpool), Kieffer Moore (Wrexham), Mark Harris (Oxford United), Dan James (Leeds United), David Brooks (Bournemouth)
digest_he:
מאמן נבחרת וויילס, קרייג בלאמי, זימן בחזרה לסגל את הארי וילסון וג'ו רודון לקראת משחקי ליגת האומות המכריעים בחודש נובמבר. הוולשים יתמודדו מול נורבגיה באוסלו ב-14 בנובמבר, ומול פורטוגל באצטדיון קארדיף סיטי ב-17 בנובמבר. וילסון נעדר מהסגל הקודם בשל פציעה בארבע ראשי, בעוד רודון החלים מפציעה במפשעה.

אל הסגל שובץ גם שער מנצ'סטר יונייטד, קארל דארלו, לצד זימונים חדשים ושחקנים ששבים מפציעות כמו רובין קולוויל וקאי אנדרוז. נבחרת וויילס נמצאת במקום השלישי בבית A4, כאשר סיום במקום הראשון או השני יעניק לה את הכרטיס לרבע הגמר, בעוד מקום שלישי יוביל למשחקי מבחן על ההישארות בדרג.
